reviewNotes:
Version 1.2 (build 20) refreshes the app icon, metal profile illustrations, Settings and lifetime Pro purchase screens. It also simplifies recent calculations and favorites, adds direct favorite removal on the home screen, and improves the light/dark appearance of the materials catalog. Native menu action labels have been restored, and Settings now accurately describes anonymous purchase information. Calculation formulas, pricing and export formats are unchanged from the approved version.

To review the updated favorite controls: open Calculate, select a profile and use the star control to save it as a favorite. Return to Calculate to remove it directly from Favorites, or choose View all to toggle its star without opening the calculation.

To review the non-consumable purchase: open Settings and tap the SteelFlow Pro card or Company profile. The paywall shows the localized App Store price for com.steelflow.app.pro.lifetime. Tap Unlock Pro to purchase, or Restore purchase to restore an existing entitlement. This is a one-time lifetime purchase, not a subscription. Pro includes unlimited projects and items, custom materials, company details and quote terms, CSV export, unbranded PDF quotes, versioned backup and bulk pricing.

Settings also includes a Rate SteelFlow link. The app uses the standard StoreKit review prompt after a completed valid calculation, with at most one request per app version and a minimum 90-day interval between requests.

No demo account is required. The app opens directly and core calculations work offline without sign-in. Project, quote, customer and material data stays on the device. RevenueCat handles anonymous purchase and entitlement information.

English and Simplified Chinese iPhone screenshots have been refreshed for this version. Screenshot project names, customers and prices are demonstration data, not live market prices.
